## Survey open-0: LIN-4457 @ cfd152fa4

`origin/main` is cfd152fa4, one commit past the 4b5001ddf grounding. That commit (LIN-4453) is docs-only, so the code is unchanged.

**Why it will be harder than "small"**

1. **There are three functions, not two.** `appCallsOf` sits between `readCalls` and `callsSurfaceOf` in `lib/cost-read.js` (:780, :823, :840), and it also calls `readCalls`. `routes/proxy-compute.js:11` imports it for S1's `appCalls`, and the `llm-call-log.test.js` tests import all three together. If only two functions move, `cost-read.js` has to import back from the new file and the calls read ends up split across two files. That undoes the split. Move `appCallsOf` too, and say so on LIN-4447.

2. **Which area should own it?** Calling this a Runs file may treat the symptom. None of the calls read's inputs or callers are in Runs. It imports `callTelemetryOf` from `lib/llm-call-log.js` (LLM & prompts). Its importers are `model-routing-spend` and `ship-biscuit` (LLM), `routes/settings` and `routes/ship-biscuit` (Web routes) and `routes/proxy-compute` (Agent API). Seams run 6 (§N6) named this two-way Runs↔LLM reach and declined to ticket a split, because LIN-4176/4179 put the calls on "the one read" on purpose. Moving the code into a new file without changing its area keeps the seam where it is and adds one more file to cross it. Putting it in LLM & prompts would be cleaner, but the binding constraint gives that side to LIN-4448 (A14). Whoever picks this up should ask, before writing the areas.json line, whether Runs is a deliberate choice.

3. **This move cannot settle the second half of Waiting 9.** The question there is "do instance-wide reads sit beside workspace-keyed stores?" It concerns `lineageRecords`/`readCost`, with the `urlKey` / `instanceWide: true` guard at `cost-read.js:159-167`, used by `kpi-stats.js:1087`. Those functions stay put. `readCalls` is pure over docs, and its callers do the workspace keying (`listInHorizon(urlKey)`). The ticket's third bullet therefore changes no code. To remove the whole entry, the PR has to say in writing that the LIN-4226 guard is the boundary. Otherwise it should rewrite entry 9 to keep that half open, not drop it silently.

4. **The areas.json edit is easy to get subtly wrong.** The Runs regex is one long alternation (`…|cost-read|row-usage|…`) and the first matching area wins. Add `cost-read-calls` explicitly; `cost-read[^/]*` would quietly widen the match. Then pin it in `area-map-placement.test.js` next to the `lib/cost-read.js` row at :15.

5. **Old references to clean up.** Repoint the four test and fixture files and four lib/route files that import from `cost-read.js`. Fix the JSDoc and doc mentions in `source-map.md:144`, `llm-call-log.js:145`, `ship-biscuit.js:338`, `render-settings.js:633`, `model-routing-spend.js:92`, `cost-format.js:33` and `cost-read.js:30`. Don't add a re-export shim, or the old home isn't really retired.

**What I'd do first**

Decide two things: (a) whether `appCallsOf` moves (I'd say yes), and (b) whether this is Runs or LLM. Post both answers on LIN-4447 before touching code. After that the move itself is mechanical. Lessons is at 4,258 bytes, so there is room. Entry 9 is the only Waiting entry this touches, and no Lesson clause names these functions.

## Survey global: LIN-4457 @ cfd152fa4

(origin/main has moved one commit past the grounding 4b5001ddf: #2422, docs only. It touches nothing this piece reads.)

**Where it lands.** `lib/cost-read.js` (854 lines) is one of the area's better-kept files. Its recent history (LIN-4179, 4201, 4226, 4276, 4404) has been consolidation: one posting-key list, one dispatch order, a census (`tests/unit/cost-read-census.test.js`) so that no surface computes its own figure. The calls code is a separate block at the end (lines 769–854). It has no store and no clock, and it shares nothing with the lineage code except the figure rule, which it states again in its own words. So the cut is clean and cheap. It doesn't touch the area's real weight (`dispatch-store.js`, the close-out splits).

**Done the obvious way, three things go wrong:**

1. **`appCallsOf` gets left behind.** It's the third calls shape, built on `readCalls` and sitting between the two named functions. Move only the two and the calls figure ends up split across two files, with `cost-read.js` importing `readCalls` back. That's the "two places" this parent exists to remove. Move all three. `EMPTY_APP_CALLS` (line 47) is already a second hand-written copy of `appCallsOf([])`, and a test pins that literal. `readCost` could use `appCallsOf([])` from the new file instead, or the constant could stay and be named as the one literal.
2. **The privacy bullet has nothing to act on.** No calls read is instance-wide. `LlmCallLogStore.listInHorizon` returns `[]` without a `urlKey`, `kpi-stats.js` never reads the call log, and all four callers (settings, ship-biscuit, proxy-compute, model-routing-spend) pass one workspace's docs to pure functions. The way to settle the second half of Waiting 9 is to *say so* in the PR and the note. It isn't to add a boundary, a wrapper or a kpi-stats-style module.
3. **Stale pointers nobody would catch.** About eight comments name `lib/cost-read.js` as the home of these functions: its own header (lines 30–31), `llm-call-log.js:39,145`, `ship-biscuit.js:338`, `render-settings.js:633`, `cost-format.js:33`, `model-routing-spend.js:92`, `tests/fixtures/cost-replay/harness.js:11` and the `llm-call-log.test.js` header. No test reads them. The census pins `listInHorizon` callers, not where `readCalls` lives, so it stays green either way. `dispatch-leftover-answer.test.js:34` uses this very entry as a literal example. It still works, but it will describe a settled entry. Leave it alone.

**Registry.** In `areas.json`, `cost-read)\.js$` → `cost-read(-calls)?)\.js$`, and add the path to the existing loop in `area-map-placement.test.js:15`. Only that test would notice the catch-all taking the file. The `callTelemetryOf` import (from `llm-call-log.js`, LLM & prompts) moves with it, so `cost-read.js` no longer depends on the call log at all. That's a small real gain.

**Worth naming, not this task's.** Every consumer of the calls figure sits outside Runs: LLM & prompts (the store, model-routing-spend, ship-biscuit), web routes, and the proxy. Runs is a defensible home, because the figure rule stays next to its lineage sibling. Even so, the file is arguably on A14's side of the seam (LIN-4448). Make the placement on purpose and record it in one line. The deeper copy is the figure rule itself ("`totalUsd` only when complete; `pricedUsd` never counts a partial"). `readCalls` and the lineage figure each implement it separately. One shared helper would retire that, but it reaches into the lineage path and its goldens, so it's larger than piece 7.

**Cheap and better:** move the three functions, settle the privacy question in words, fix the pointers, and optionally give the calls tests their own `cost-read-calls.test.js` (today they live in `llm-call-log.test.js`). Lessons are at 4,269 bytes, so there's room for a one-line clause if one is needed.

## LIN-4457 (piece 7): PR ready for review

PR: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2424 (commit 4ea44e537, branch `feat/lin-4457-cost-read-calls-file`)

- Moved `readCalls`, `appCallsOf` and `callsSurfaceOf` from `lib/cost-read.js` to `lib/cost-read-calls.js`. `readCost` defaults to `appCallsOf([])`, replacing the restated `EMPTY_APP_CALLS` literal.
- `areas.json`: exact Runs pattern `cost-read(?:-calls)?\.js$`. Witness: `area-map-placement.test.js` fails on the unfixed registry (`actual 'Other features'`).
- Waiting 9 settled in `docs/areas/runs-and-dispatch.md`, with a Lesson on the instance-wide boundary (LIN-4226 guard, unchanged).
- Unit tests: 2429 pass, 0 fail across 76 files that touch the moved code.
- CI: all checks green on the PR, including `CI success` (Unit tests, Unit tests (proxy, clock +400d), E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan).
- Retires: the calls figure's place in `lib/cost-read.js`, its direct call-log import, and the restated empty-app-calls literal.

### Leftovers

- The calls read's pure tests sat in `tests/unit/llm-call-log.test.js`, beside the old owner's neighbour. Tidied: they moved to `tests/unit/cost-read-calls.test.js`, and the store-fed reads stay with the call log (27 tests before and after).
- The figure rule is stated twice, in `readCalls` and in the lineage figure (`lib/cost-read.js`), so a change to the rule must be made in both. A shared helper reaches the lineage goldens, so this is larger than a fix. Noted: a Waiting entry in `docs/areas/runs-and-dispatch.md` (`lib/cost-read-calls.js`).
- `tests/unit/dispatch-leftover-answer.test.js` uses the settled Waiting 9 as a literal example. Nothing to do: the example is still valid as a string, and the ticket said to leave it unchanged.
- No ticket-bound finds for close-out.

Retires: `lib/render-proxy.js`: the Proxy scope `select.proxy-scope-select` has no accessible name

The settled entry is in Front end: server-rendered pages. LLM & prompts, the busiest touched area, belongs to LIN-4448 (A14), and Runs' entries are all assigned to sibling pieces or say why not. The Tokens form's label input and scope select now carry aria-labels. Witness: `tests/unit/proxy-page-accessible-names.test.js` fails 2 of 4 on the unfixed render.

PR: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2424, head `812d9adbb5e767fbad44e4a3cccd31783637220a`. CI is green on that head (Unit tests, Unit tests (proxy, clock +400d), E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan, CI success).

## Review — LIN-4457

Reviewed PR #2424 (https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2424), head `812d9adbb5e767fbad44e4a3cccd31783637220a`, based on `cfd152fa4`.

CI: green on head 812d9adbb (Unit tests, Unit tests (proxy, clock +400d), E2E 1–4, Secret scan, CI success). **However, the PR is `CONFLICTING` with origin/main `92676b1fe` (LIN-4446)**, so that green run is not on a mergeable commit. See the ledger.

### Re-grounding
Since the ticket was filed, `origin/main` has moved two commits: cfd152fa4 (docs only) and 92676b1fe (LIN-4446, cost formatter). Neither touches `lib/cost-read.js`, `lib/llm-call-log.js`, `areas.json` or any calls importer, so the ticket's description of the code still holds. 92676b1fe *does* edit `docs/areas/front-end-pages.md` (it removed the `render-swipe.js` Waiting entry) and `source-map.md` (auto-merges cleanly).

### Against what was asked
- **Move `readCalls` and `callsSurfaceOf` into `lib/cost-read-calls.js`:** met. `appCallsOf` moved too. That was a deliberate expansion, recorded on LIN-4447 before implementation (comment a3dab3f7), and both surveys recommended it. No shim is left: no file imports a calls function from `cost-read.js`. `cost-read.js` no longer imports `llm-call-log.js`.
- **Explicit Runs pattern in `areas.json`:** met. `cost-read(?:-calls)?` is exact, with no `[^/]*` widening.
- **Keep instance-wide reads outside workspace-keyed stores:** met in words, which is the right outcome. No calls read is instance-wide, and callers key the docs with `listInHorizon(urlKey)`. The LIN-4226 `urlKey`/`instanceWide` guard is unchanged and is now named in a Lesson (`docs/areas/runs-and-dispatch.md`).
- **Retires / Settles Waiting 9:** met. The entry is removed in the same change. `dispatch-leftover-answer.test.js:34` is left unchanged, as the ticket's constraint says.
- **Witness:** met. `area-map-placement.test.js` pins the new path, and the existing cost tests are green.
- **Binding constraints:** met. Nothing stores readiness and there are no new GitHub or provider reads. Lessons are 4,681 bytes (under 6,144). The PR names what it retires. No history is recomputed and no prompt changelog is touched. On the LLM side, `lib/llm-call-log.js` changes in comments only (two pointers), so A14's side is not changed.
- **Placement in Runs** is recorded on the parent as deliberate. The Runs-vs-LLM question stays open and is not blocking (a3dab3f7). That answers the brief's second open question.
- **`render-proxy.js` aria-labels (the brief's first open question):** this is the builder's leave-it-better leftover. Its `Retires:` line names the `front-end-pages.md` Waiting entry this diff removes, which is the required check, and it has its own witness. It is in process, not scope creep.

### Regression check
`git log` on the touched files (LIN-4404, 4405, 4420–4422, 4358) shows no fix this change undoes and no revert it re-applies. `readCost`'s default `appCallsOf([])` returns the same value as the old `EMPTY_APP_CALLS` literal.

### Test quality and mutations (each one reverted afterwards)
- `areas.json` pattern reverted to `cost-read`: `area-map-placement` **1 fail**.
- aria-labels removed from `render-proxy.js`: `proxy-page-accessible-names` **2 of 4 fail**.
- `readCalls` `totalUsd: pricedUsd` (figure rule broken): **3 fail** across `cost-read-calls` and `llm-call-log` tests.
- `readCost` default `appSummary || {}`: **2 fail** in the cost tests.
- `appCallsOf` `costUsd: 0`: **1 fail**. `callsSurfaceOf` `totalTokens: 0`: **2 fail**.
- Test count is preserved: `llm-call-log.test.js` had 27 tests on base. On the PR there are 21 there plus 6 in `cost-read-calls.test.js`.
- For a pure move the right test level is unit. Server boot in E2E covers the three repointed route imports.

### Independent run on the merged tree
I made a trial merge of the PR into origin/main 92676b1fe and resolved the conflict below. `npm run test:unit` gave **25,305 pass, 0 fail**.

### Isolated, or one of a class?
I searched for the calls figure and the empty-calls shape restated elsewhere in `lib/`, `routes/` and `public/`. The only copy is the figure rule in the lineage figure (`cost-read.js:681`). The builder recorded it as a new Runs Waiting entry with its reason (it reaches the lineage goldens). It is **outside** this piece's bounded class, which is moving the calls reads, and its home is that Waiting entry, already written. It does sit inside the parent's "each rule has one home", so LIN-4447 should carry it forward. Otherwise the change is isolated.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **Inside: the PR must land on a mergeable commit.** It conflicts with origin/main in `docs/areas/front-end-pages.md` `## Waiting`. The PR removed the `render-proxy.js` scope-select/label entry, and main (LIN-4446) removed the `render-swipe.js` `user-scalable=no` entry next to it. **Settle before the merge:** merge or rebase onto main and resolve by keeping *neither* line. Note that the separate `render-proxy.js` "interact with Linear" entry must stay. Then CI must be green on the resolved commit. Right/wrong condition: after the merge, `grep -c 'proxy-scope-select\|user-scalable=no' docs/areas/front-end-pages.md` is 0, and `CI success` passes on the new head. I resolved it this way locally and the unit suite was green, but that run is not a substitute for CI on the pushed commit.

### Fixes for close-out
1. Resolve the conflict as described in the ledger, push, and confirm CI is green on the new head.
2. The PR body is stale against the leftovers commit 812d9adbb. Add a "Leftovers" section to it covering two things: the calls tests moved to `tests/unit/cost-read-calls.test.js`, and the Tokens-form `aria-label`s in `lib/render-proxy.js` that retire the `front-end-pages.md` Waiting entry, with witness `proxy-page-accessible-names.test.js`. Also correct the line "`llm-call-log.test.js` still pins the literal empty shape" to `tests/unit/cost-read-calls.test.js` (`appCallsOf([])` deepStrictEqual), which is where it now lives.

### Verdict
Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger

## Blind read Verdict: better. `lib/cost-read.js` now holds lineage figures only: the Harbour calls read (`readCalls`, `appCallsOf`, `callsSurfaceOf`) has its own module, `lib/cost-read-calls.js`. Its tests moved out of `tests/unit/llm-call-log.test.js` into a matching `tests/unit/cost-read-calls.test.js`, and the duplicate `EMPTY_APP_CALLS` literal is gone in favour of `appCallsOf([])`. Every importer, the registry, the placement test and the source map learned about the move. The one thing it made worse is that the new module sits in runs-and-dispatch by name only, while its dependency and nearly all its consumers live elsewhere (`lib/cost-read-calls.js`). Read: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2424 at `812d9adbb` against `cfd152fa4`. ### Inside the area, fix-sized - `lib/cost-read-calls.js` (runs-and-dispatch): the header doesn't explain why the module is owned by Runs & dispatch. It sends the reader to a tracker note instead ("see the LIN-4457 placement note on LIN-4447"), which the next change can't follow from the code. Fix: put the reason in one sentence in the header, or drop the pointer. - `tests/unit/proxy-page-accessible-names.test.js` (front-end-pages, via `lib/render-proxy.js`): the Agent Prompt test matches the exact markup sequence `

## Merge-order note from LIN-4454

PR #2425 (LIN-4454, model attribution from the cost fold) merged first, as `c205190fd`, so the shared `docs/areas/runs-and-dispatch.md` rebase now falls to this PR (#2424). It shortens the Lesson this PR adds after, and removes a Waiting entry. After rebasing, check that: the Lessons line ends at "…never re-ranks `byModel` itself. (Drift & Coherence Review…)" with no `dispatchModelOf` tail; this PR's own Lesson is still present; no Waiting entry contains `dispatchModelOf`; Lessons is under 6,144 bytes; CI is green on the rebased head. Also still open and unowned: whether `byModel` should carry `pricedUsd` or document that its order is the rank, which is natural to look at while `lib/cost-read.js` is being split.

## Close-out — LIN-4457

**Merged:** PR [#2424](https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2424) into `main` as `5dcf5bcda`, merge pinned to head `b708a9815` (`--match-head-commit`). The calls reads (`readCalls`, `appCallsOf`, `callsSurfaceOf`) now live in `lib/cost-read-calls.js`, with an exact Runs pattern `cost-read(?:-calls)?` in `areas.json`. Waiting 9 is settled. Review's account covers how this meets the ask.

**CI:** exists (`.github/workflows/test.yml`). Green on the exact merged head `b708a9815`: Unit tests, Unit tests (proxy, clock +400d), E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan, CI success. Before pushing I also ran `npm run test:unit` locally on the merged tree: 25,349 pass, 0 fail. Main's own CI run on `5dcf5bcda` was still in progress when I wrote this.

**Changes I made after approval** (nobody reviews these, so each is listed):
- `039696803` — merged `origin/main` (`2bf788b6d`). Conflict in `docs/areas/front-end-pages.md` Waiting, resolved as review's ledger said: neither the settled `proxy-scope-select` entry nor main's settled `user-scalable=no` entry is kept; the `render-proxy.js` "interact with Linear" entry stays. `grep -c 'proxy-scope-select\|user-scalable=no'` on the file is 0. *(Review ledger item.)*
- `c148952f9` — blind-read fix 1: the `lib/cost-read-calls.js` header gives the Runs placement reason itself (kept beside `cost-read.js` as the cost-read family; import and consumers sit in other areas) instead of pointing at a LIN-4447 note. Blind-read fix 2: `tests/unit/proxy-page-accessible-names.test.js` inspects the containing `proxy-scope-toggle` label block and the select id, not exact markup order. I confirmed it passes with the select's attributes reordered.
- `b708a9815` — main moved again (LIN-4454, #2425) and conflicted in `docs/areas/runs-and-dispatch.md` Lessons. Resolved by taking main's per-dispatch-figure line (the `dispatchModelOf` clause is retired there) and keeping this PR's calls-read Lesson. Lessons are 4,594 bytes (under 6,144).
- The PR body now has a Leftovers and Close-out section: the calls-test move, the Tokens-form aria-labels with witness `proxy-page-accessible-names.test.js`, and the empty-shape assertion corrected to `tests/unit/cost-read-calls.test.js`. *(Review fix 2.)*

**Ledger:**
- Inside, mergeable commit and CI on the new head: done (above). My unit run and review's trial-merge run did not stand in for CI; the CI run on `b708a9815` did.
- Outside, figure rule stated in both `readCalls` and the lineage figure: settled by its Runs Waiting entry (written in the PR). It reaches the lineage goldens, and review said LIN-4447 carries it forward. No ticket: nothing is wrong today.
- Runs-vs-LLM ownership: nonblocking, recorded as deliberate on LIN-4447 (`a3dab3f7`). The blind read's "larger" finding is a cross-area decision and not fix-sized. It stays on LIN-4447 and is not re-raised.
- Blind read: both fix-sized finds fixed (above); it had no outside finds.

**Post-merge check on the merged commit `5dcf5bcda`:** `lib/cost-read-calls.js` exists. `cost-read.js` only imports `appCallsOf` for the empty default, with no shim. The `area-map-placement`, `cost-read-calls`, `proxy-page-accessible-names` and `llm-call-log` tests pass (42 pass, 0 fail). The review ledger named no live-only check.

**Not run:** I could not read a deploy commit (no deploy workflow in the repo, and the page footer isn't reachable from this session). The change is a behaviour-preserving move plus aria-labels, and no ledger item needs the live app. If an operator wants it, check that the Harbour footer shows `5dcf5bcda` or later and that Settings › Health still renders its calls surface.

**Follow-up tickets filed:** none. The outside items are covered by Waiting entries or LIN-4447. Related tickets: LIN-4458 and LIN-4459 are later pieces this one blocks, and both remain open work.
**Archive/prune:** see the next step in this comment trail.

## Autopilot run summary — LIN-4457

Run `76a04a60`, scoped to this one task. It ended with the task Done and PR #2424 merged.

**Steps run (kind sequence converged, nothing repeated):**
1. `survey-task` (cae17a6c) — comment fe611f7b: `appCallsOf` must move too; Runs-vs-LLM placement; the privacy bullet needs words, not code.
2. `survey-place` (3125dbef) — comment 6291095a: same findings.
3. `scoping` (d00de3c4) — size record in the description: a small tidy, no cuts.
4. `implementation` (dde3c4fb) — PR #2424.
5. `review` (38a52afb) — comment 4ded07b7: Approve, conditional. One inside ledger item: the conflict in `front-end-pages.md`.
6. `blind-read` (382a10d7) — comment eebd03c0: better. Two fix-sized finds.
7. `close-out` (fde41b5a) — comment df307b9d: merged, Done.

**Evidence checked by the orchestrator, not taken from worker reports:**
- PR #2424 state MERGED, merge commit `5dcf5bcda`, pinned to head `b708a9815`.
- All 8 CI checks (Unit, Unit proxy, E2E 1-4, Secret scan, CI success) passed on head `b708a9815`.
- On `5dcf5bcda`: `lib/cost-read-calls.js` exists; `cost-read.js` only imports `appCallsOf` for the empty default, with no re-export shim; the ledger grep on `front-end-pages.md` returns 0.
- Issue state is Done.

**What is left:**
- Main's own post-merge CI run on `5dcf5bcda` was still in progress when I looked. Only the Secret scan had finished (success).
- No deploy check was run: the repo has no deploy workflow and close-out could not read a deploy commit. The change is a behaviour-preserving move plus aria-labels.
- The Runs-vs-LLM ownership of the new file stays open on LIN-4447 (a3dab3f7). The duplicated figure rule is tracked as a Runs Waiting entry.
- The engine now suggests a `retrospective-audit`. It was not started because this run was scoped to getting LIN-4457 Done.

description:
## As asked

**Parent:** LIN-4447 (Runs & dispatch, left simpler). The parent's scope is its `## As asked` block. Its approved design and plan are the `## Design` and `## Implementation Plan` sections of the parent description, and the Design comment (6efb91fa) holds the full analysis. **Start from the parent's approved plan and follow it. Where the code shows it is wrong, change course and say so in a comment on LIN-4447.**
**Repository:** JKershaw/LinearViewer. **Grounding commit:** `origin/main` 4b5001ddf. On 2026-11-13 at 14:00Z it was still HEAD, with nothing landed since the ticket was filed.

## Piece 7 (small): cost-call reads get their own Runs file

**Approach:**

* Move `readCalls` and `callsSurfaceOf` from `lib/cost-read.js` into `lib/cost-read-calls.js`.
* Add an explicit Runs pattern for the new file to `docs/areas/areas.json` in the same change. Today's `cost-read)\.js$` pattern does not match it, so the file would fall to the `^lib/` catch-all.
* Keep instance-wide reads outside workspace-keyed stores, as `kpi-stats` does, for the privacy boundary.

**Retires:** the two functions' place in `cost-read.js`. **Settles Waiting:** 9.
**Testing / witness:** `area-map-placement.test.js` pins `lib/cost-read-calls.js` to Runs, and the existing cost tests stay green.

Session fit: fits one session
Plan-review due: no — covered by LIN-4447's approving plan-review (comment 12619798-1986-467f-b67c-8bed766a7813, rev 2)

**Binding for every piece (from the parent's Constraints):** compute readiness from the trail on read and never store it. Add no GitHub or provider reads. In the same change, remove the Waiting entries this piece settles and any stale Lesson clause in `docs/areas/runs-and-dispatch.md`, and keep Lessons under 6,144 bytes. Say in the PR what this piece retires. Never recompute stored pre-cutover history, and never edit recorded prompt changelog text. The LLM & prompts side of the seam belongs to LIN-4448 (A14).

*End of what was asked. Steps write below this line; nothing above it changes.*

## Size of the move

**Size:** a small tidy
**Why:** Moves the issue-level app calls shape with the two named calls readers, so the whole calls figure leaves the one cost read rather than splitting across two files; the shared figure rule stays out, as it reaches lineage figures.
**Cuts:** none
**Decided by:** the standing policy

## Implemented

The Runs pattern in `docs/areas/areas.json` is `cost-read(?:-calls)?`, and Waiting 9 is settled. Besides the plan, the PR retired a Front end Waiting entry with the Tokens-form aria-labels.
